name: Pinned Numbered Testimonials
description: A pinned testimonial stage where giant numerals 01, 02, 03 crossfade in sequence as you scroll, each paired with a large quote and author that slide-fade through, scrubbed by GSAP ScrollTrigger with snap to every testimonial and a progress hairline on the side.
usage: Copy styles.css and animation.js, add a .pnt-section containing a .pnt-inner with the .pnt-rail hairline and one .pnt-item figure (numeral, quote, author) per testimonial, load GSAP plus ScrollTrigger, then call initNumberedTestimonials(). Without JavaScript or with reduced motion the same markup renders as a plain readable list.
source: Pattern seen on https://coffee-tech.com (Awwwards SOTD by MAKETHECUT and Or Halevi), implemented from scratch
